03 · Materials and construction

What's Included in Your Carriage Lane

A practical construction package designed around weather protection, utility, and everyday use. Final framing and supports vary as required by building dimensions and site conditions.

Foundation Supports

4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams supported on 16″ × 16″ × 4″ solid concrete pads on qualifying sites.

Floor Construction

2×6 pressure-treated floor joists at 16″ on center with ¾″ exterior-grade plywood decking, subject to size-specific structural requirements.

Roof Structure

Standard 5/12 gable roof with engineered trusses and ½″ exterior-grade plywood roof sheathing.

Roof Finish

Architectural roof shingles with a selection of available colors. Specific material warranties are provided by the manufacturer.

Windows & Doors

Two 24″ × 30″ aluminum-framed windows with screens and locks, plus a 5′ × 80″ Craftsman-style double-door unit with keyed hardware.

Exterior & Details

Standard Roseburg DuraTemp wood siding, cedar trim and decorative shutters, with screened louver ventilation.

09 · Good questions, clear answers

Frequently Asked Questions

Is Roseburg DuraTemp included in the displayed starting price?

Yes. DuraTemp wood siding is the standard siding selection and is preselected in the calculator. Four additional siding selections are available for comparison.

Will my Carriage Lane be built at my property?

Yes. Appalachian Sheds constructs the Carriage Lane on site with a qualified crew. The final scope and schedule are confirmed in writing.

What is included in the foundation price?

The standard construction package includes 4×6 pressure-treated foundation beams on 16″ × 16″ × 4″ solid concrete support pads for qualifying sites. The existing grade should not exceed a 6″ variation across the building footprint for standard leveling. Additional work is quoted separately.

Are the two windows and double doors included?

Yes. The standard Carriage Lane configuration includes two 24″ × 30″ windows and a 5′ Craftsman-style double-door unit, as described in the specifications.

Can I choose a steeper roof pitch?

The listed prices are for the standard 5/12 roof. Other roof configurations may be reviewed through a custom written proposal, subject to design feasibility and confirmed pricing.

How do warranties work?

Appalachian Sheds provides a written warranty covering the applicable work and terms. Individual material manufacturers may provide separate warranties. Review the written warranty and relevant manufacturer documentation with your proposal.

Will I know about site preparation costs before building begins?

We recommend a property walk-through to review access, grade, support conditions and any preparation needed. Additional site work and the agreed project scope are identified in writing.
